host: WSL2 Ubuntu with bwrap installed; linux amd64 test binary
observed: A normal fixed command runs inside bubblewrap.
Writing to /etc fails because the root is read-only.
No eth0 appears in the sandbox /proc/net/dev.
With a temporary-disk limit, the per-run working directory is bound read-write and a file can be written there.
A busy loop under a 100ms CPU limit stopped in about 0.12s after RSS and CPU sampling was changed to sum the process group.
scope: The linux-bwrap profile only. This is not a claim that every absolute path is unreachable through other mounts, and it is not a publication approval.
